Pretrained models

Source: R/models.R
fb_model_pretrained.Rd

Models trained with fb_train() and fb_fit_fusion() on the reference tiles of the validation, with delineation thresholds tuned on separate tiles of the same regions:

Usage

fb_model_pretrained(
  region = c("general", "california", "ftw"),
  type = c("tbc", "fusion")
)

Arguments

region

Model name.

type

"tbc" for the TBC model, "fusion" for the fusion with the PRUE B3 model (not available for "ftw").

Value

An fb_model or fb_fusion object.

Details

  • "general" (default): fitted on 44 tiles in California (2024) and 31 tiles in Washington (2024 and 2025) together, thresholds tuned on 22 and 15 further tiles; the model to use where no local reference fields exist.

  • "california": fitted on the 44 California tiles, thresholds tuned on 22.

  • "ftw": fitted on 89 Fields of The World benchmark chips from six countries, using the four 10 m bands only, thresholds tuned on the California and Washington tiles; in the validation, a model fitted this way transferred to annual crops but not to perennial crops.

The cropland learner of the "general" and "california" models was chosen among ridge logistic regression, random forest and gradient-boosted trees by object F1 on the tuning tiles (gradient-boosted trees in both); the "ftw" model uses gradient-boosted trees. The models were fitted on Sentinel-2 images resampled to the Fields of The World chip grid (about 5 m); the minimum field size is stored in pixels and as an area (min_area, square metres), which fb_delineate() uses, so that it keeps its meaning at other pixel sizes. In all models the tuned minimum field size is about 1.1 ha, the largest value of the tuning grid, which suits the large fields of the tuning regions; where fields are smaller, pass a smaller min_area to fb_delineate(). The fusion models combine TBC with PRUE B3 probabilities from the March and July scenes. The test tiles of the validation were not used to fit or tune any model.

Examples

fb_model_pretrained()
#> <fb_model> temporal boundary contrast
#>   bands            : B02, B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B08, B8A, B11, B12 
#>   edge features    : ND(B03,B08) | ND(B02,B07) | B04 | ND(B04,B11) | ND(B03,B11) | ND(B08,B11) | B08 | ND(B02,B05) 
#>   cropland learner : xgboost 
#>   training         : 75 tiles, 467,670 pairs (167,670 across), 1,470,140 pixels
#>   in-sample AUC    : edge 0.902, cropland 0.968
#>   thresholds       : t_edge 0.60, t_field 0.30, min_size 400 pixels
fb_model_pretrained("california", "fusion")
#> <fb_fusion> logistic fusion of deep-model and TBC maps
#>   boundary: -0.899 + 0.044 logit P(boundary) + 0.978 logit(edge)
#>   field   : -0.230 + 0.095 logit P(field + boundary) + 1.063 logit(cropland)
#>   thresholds: t_edge 0.30, t_field 0.30, min_size 400 pixels
